parameters.name: X-Wallet-Id
parameters.description: Optional. Selects the distribution account whose trustline is removed. Omit it to act on the tenant's default account. An API key does not get that fallback: it resolves the account the same way other writes do, so a key scoped to exactly one account may omit the header and any other key must send it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the asset to delete
